# Stamp inner borders: accepted reference and bounded native mapping

Tracking [#91](https://github.com/amhbamhb/StampAlbumGen2/issues/91),
branch `issue/91-stamp-inner-borders`, based on `697eb0d3` (#90).
The maintainer approved the reference: "yes approved. continue with the
process". The bounded native mapping is implemented; native visual/Actual-size
print acceptance remains pending. No commit/push, PR, production integration
or OKF regeneration is included.

## Complete-page reference

[album.txt](album.txt) contains AlbumEasy commands only.
[album.pdf](album.pdf) is generated by AlbumEasy 4.5.0, not the native renderer.
It has two exact US Letter pages (215.9 x 279.4 mm, 612 x 792 pt), six real
images per page, page borders, title, readable captions, numbered footers
and visible left margin text. Existing references remain untouched.

| Page / row | Case |
|---|---|
| 1 / 1 | Darkblue SOLID inner frame, 2 mm padding / 0.2 mm thickness, persistent across two stamps |
| 1 / 2 | Darkred DOTTED then DASHED, British colour spelling |
| 1 / 3 | Darkgreen DOT_DASH then inner BLANK; outer border retained |
| 2 / 1 | Save blue 2/0.2 settings; temporary red 1/0.35; restore blue settings within the row |
| 2 / 2 | Cancel with `(0 0)` then re-enable `(2 0.2)` |
| 2 / 3 | `NO_FRAME` suppresses both frames; outer BLANK suppresses outer frame but **retains inner frame** |

Both pages were visually inspected at 1200 pixels. No caption overlap,
obvious clipping or missing images was observed. Human visual/Actual-size
print acceptance remains pending; screen review does not certify physical print.

## Reference grammar and measured behavior

Pinned AlbumEasy 4.5.0 help QCH SHA-256:
`8b81707d861aacceb798b9f38efbbfdc3ea86fa49a57b7e343c3a25d5964d5be`.
Inner-border/style help is at extracted lines 994-1075; colour commands
and saved-state checklist are also documented in the pinned help.

```text
STAMP_INNER_BORDER (padding border)
STAMP_INNER_BORDER_STYLE (Style)
COLOR_STAMP_INNER_BORDER (colour)
COLOUR_STAMP_INNER_BORDER (colour)
```

Padding and thickness are mm; `(0 0)` cancels. The help restricts inner
frames to nonrotated rectangular stamp boxes. This first pass covers SOLID,
DOTTED, DASHED, DOT_DASH and BLANK only. CORNER/SIDES selectors, independent
side-mask persistence and interactions with shapes/rotation remain explicit
later mapping/proof obligations, not silently certified.

Actual MuPDF trace evidence:

- Page 1 has 20 coloured inner side strokes (five rectangles); page 2 has
  16 (four rectangles). Six real image draws appear on each page.
- Normal thickness is 0.56693 pt (0.2 mm); temporary thickness 0.99213 pt
  (0.35 mm). Dash arrays: DOTTED `[1]`, DASHED `[3 2 3 2]`,
  DOT_DASH `[3 2 1 2]`, each with phase 0; values are points.
- Styles/colour change at individual stamps, including within an open row.
  Save/restore reinstates padding, thickness and colour. Cancellation and
  inner BLANK remove the inner stroke without removing the image.
- Important distinction: outer BLANK still draws a solid inner frame,
  unlike `NO_FRAME`. Do not gate inner rendering solely on outer-outline
  visibility in the native implementation.
- AlbumEasy draws separate side segments with thickness-related endpoint/
  baseline adjustments rather than one naive inset rectangle. For example
  the first inner vertical left line is at x=139.41733 pt, while its
  horizontal endpoint is x=139.13387 pt (half the 0.56693-pt thickness).
  Native geometry must be measured against these actual paths before
  claiming conformance; padding is not yet certified as a simple centreline
  inset from the outer rectangle.

## Implemented native mapping

Shared [typed inner-frame layout](../../../../src/native_pdf/stamp_inner_border.rs)
stores padding, thickness, ordinary style and colour. Compatibility captures
all inner state per stamp, including changes inside an open row; save/restore
includes dimensions, style and colour even while disabled. The native saved
frame state likewise includes the inner border. Image bounds, row footprints
and physical clearance are not resized by an inner frame.

Explicit native grammar (exactly four arguments):

```text
NATIVE_STAMP_INNER_BORDER (2 0.2 SOLID darkblue)
NATIVE_STAMP_INNER_BORDER (0 0 SOLID darkblue)
```

Arguments: padding mm, thickness mm, style, named colour. All values are
document settings, with no new TOML keys or silent native numeric defaults.
The second command cancels. `NATIVE_STAMP_OUTLINE (hide)` alone models an
outer BLANK and retains an enabled inner border; a native NO_FRAME equivalent
explicitly hides the outer outline and cancels the inner setting (and
background if one was requested). The fixture comments show both cases.
SOLID/DOTTED/DASHED/DOT_DASH/BLANK are supported on the currently mapped
rectangular image boxes; CORNER/SIDES still error. This does not introduce
text-only `STAMP_ADD` or other previously unmapped stamp constructors.

For a frame with nominal bounds, each inner side's centreline is inset by
`padding + (outer_thickness + inner_thickness) / 2`. Vertical side endpoints
extend half an inner thickness vertically, while horizontal endpoints extend
half a thickness horizontally. This is the measured stroke-edge gap model,
not an ordinary inset rectangle. Blank inner styles retain validated state
but emit no paths. Invalid/oversized visible geometry fails before writing
the PDF; existing output is preserved.

Graphics state is saved/restored around each inner rectangle's four separate
side strokes. Dash arrays use the observed point values with phase zero;
the image/text/outer-border graphics state is not contaminated.

| Input | Native PDF |
|---|---|
| [Original accepted AlbumEasy TXT](album.txt) | [TXT-native](album-txt-native.pdf) |
| [Byte-identical raw AlbumEasy `.stampalbum`](album-raw.stampalbum) | [Raw-native](album-raw-native.pdf) |
| [Native-language `.stampalbum`](album.stampalbum) | [Native-language PDF](album-native.pdf) |

All three render two Letter pages/12 images, 20/16 inner side strokes,
page borders, visible left margin and every footer. Tests parse actual
reference/native PDF operations and compare all ordinary inner side
coordinates **after translation** within 0.02 pt, thickness within 0.01 pt,
colour within 0.001 RGB and identical dash arrays. Translation is necessary:
native and compatibility row/title placement still differ from AlbumEasy.
This does not certify absolute placement or whole-page pixel parity.
TXT/raw decoded contents and both 1200-pixel page rasters are identical.
Physical image dimensions agree between native-language and TXT routes
within 0.02 pt.

### Supplemental zero-value reference

[zero-values.txt](zero-values.txt) /
[AlbumEasy PDF](zero-values.pdf) are a separate one-page/four-image probe,
not a modification to the accepted two-page reference.

- `(0 0.2)` draws an inner frame with zero edge gap.
- `(2 0)` draws a **PDF hairline**, not cancellation. Actual reference
  paths have linewidth 0, and the native writer preserves that meaning.
- `(0 0)` cancels; later `(2 0.2)` re-enables normally.

The [zero-values TXT-native PDF](zero-values-txt-native.pdf) and runnable
tests preserve all three behaviors. Twelve coloured side strokes appear
in this probe, four with hairline width. Device-dependent hairline visibility
is expected PDF behavior, not a configurable physical stroke thickness.

```sh

cargo test --test native_pdf_stamp_inner_border regenerate_inner_border_proofs -- --ignored --nocapture
```

The full scoped regression gate adds `--test native_pdf_stamp_inner_border`
to the exact 17-suite command in the
[margin report](../margin-text-v1/README.md#native-validation-execution-report).
It retains all previous TXT/raw/native suites plus a non-mutating Denmark

for both inputs, no deferrals, source bytes unchanged. No historical PDF
is regenerated by normal tests.

```sh

git diff --check
```

This includes six new inner-border tests, the non-mutating Denmark check
and the earlier 108 passing regressions. The explicit proof generator passed
separately (exit 0, one test). All-target checking passed with only pre-existing
library warnings. Final focused Clippy, format and whitespace checks passed
(exit 0), with no new test warnings. Final affected-suite rerun passed 16
tests/3 ignored/zero failed. The final proof generator passed one test and
wrote all four main/supplemental native PDFs. Accepted reference TXT/PDF

Development error inventory: the first compile placed new command arms
inside the outer-style match; fixed arm scope. Initial tests expected

An accidentally nested test was moved to module scope so Cargo executes it.
Old unsupported-command sentinels were changed only where inner-border
support invalidated them; unmapped footer padding/CORNER still fail.
The zero probe disproved an initial zero-thickness rejection; hairline
mapping now follows actual reference evidence, without silent fallback.
An initial CLI image-list assertion counted 24 entries because it included

all three CLI outputs have 12 real image placements. No runtime fix was
needed for that inspection error.

Remaining boundaries: inner CORNER/SIDES and shape/rotation interactions,

Letter print review. Production integration, PR and OKF remain deferred.
